scenes.title: Hook
scenes.step_card: The timber look. Without the weight.
scenes.narration: Want the look of old timber beams, without the weight?

scenes.title: Real up close
scenes.narration: Meet Heritage Timber, by Ekena Millwork. Each beam is cast from real, weathered timber, so it looks solid, even up close.

actions.label: Cast from real timber + Up close / Across the room

scenes.title: The weight
scenes.narration: A five-and-a-half-inch beam, twelve feet long, ships at about eighteen pounds. One person can lift it.

scenes.title: One-person install
scenes.step_card: One-person install. Slides over a block.
scenes.narration: It slides over a wood block, with standard household tools. And it's hollow, so it can hide wiring.

scenes.title: Why not solid wood?
scenes.narration: And unlike solid wood, it resists warping and cracking, with less upkeep.

scenes.title: Real homes
scenes.narration: And here it is, in real customers' homes.

actions.label: Real customer installs on the beat

scenes.title: Finish and size
scenes.narration: Pick from six hand-stained finishes, or primed. Eight cross-section sizes, in lengths from four to twenty-four feet.

actions.label: Finishes change in the room on the beat

scenes.title: Quick Ship
scenes.narration: It's in stock, and usually ships in three to five business days.

scenes.title: End card
scenes.narration: Order a sample, and see it in your own light.

changes.summary: Root cause: the renderer read the old Peaceful beat file for cuts inside scenes. timeline.json now records the beat file it was cut to (music_beats) and the renderer reads that. Montage photo changes and finish changes now sit on Sunlit Groove beats: every other beat (about 1 s) where they fit, every beat otherwise (9:16 montage). Dissolves are centred on the beat. Timeline bpm now the median beat period (123.05).
End-card site still waits on Brody (ekenamillwork.com or FauxBeams.com).
The soft windmill-fan photo (ed0ccc91) is replaced by the sharper entry-hall install acdc4e8b.
